r: V_12P0 not available / not detected / timeout. -> Check short on V_12P0, bad powersupply? check V_EXT (R5R20, R5R19), check PSU_V12P0_EN (R9A2, R9B2)
V_5P0 not available / timeout. -> Check short on V_5P0, check U3E2, Q3E1, Q3E2 and surrounding resistors.

PWRGPA timeout / not reporting PWRGD -> Check short on V_3P3, V_SOC1P8PLL, VMEMIOAB/CD, VTT[ABCD]. Pull VREG_PWRGPA_EN to V_3P3STBY manually and check V_3P3, V_SOC1P8PLL, VMEMIOAB/CD, (VTT[ABCD]) voltages.
PWRGPB timeout / not reporting PWRGD -> Check short on V_SOCPHY, V_NBCORE, V_MEMCORE. Pull VREG_PWRGPB_EN to V_3P3STBY manually and check V_FUSE, V_SOCPHY, V_NBCORE, V_MEMCORE voltages.

CPUGFX_PWRGD timeout / not reporting PWRGD -> Check short on V_CPUCORE, V_GFXCORE (they can be low resistance, dont confuse with a short!), check R9C64, U9D2, U9D3, U9D4, U9E1, U9E2 drivers, 10 mosfets, surrounding resistors and U9C2.
U3E2 I2C unreachable -> Check surrounding traces, R3E18, R3E20, replace U3E2
NCP4204 I2C unreachable -> Check R9C1, R9C2, surrounding traces, replace U9C2
U9F2 I2C unreachable -> Check surrounding traces, R9F11, R9F6, replace U9F2
U6C1 I2C unreachable -> Check surrounding traces, R5C11, R5C10, replace U6C1
Thrown when console unplugged unexpectedly, check powersupply. 12V unstable, maybe V_EXT (R5R20, R5R19), check PSU_V12P0_EN (R9A2, R9B2)
Thrown when console unplugged unexpectedly, check powersupply. Unstable V_5P0, check C3E15.
Thrown when console unplugged unexpectedly, VREG_PWRGPA_PWRGD went low while console was on, V_3P3, V_SOC1P8PLL, VMEMIOAB/CD, VTT[ABCD] unstable. Check C4F21, C9E11 and C6C14.
Thrown when console unplugged unexpectedly, SBPOWERUP2 failed while console is on, unstable
Thrown when console unplugged unexpectedly, VREG_PWRGPB_PWRGD went low while console was on, V_FUSE, V_SOCPHY, V_NBCORE or V_MEMCORE unstable. Check C6F9, C6F12 and C6E15.

Thrown when console unplugged unexpectedly, CPUGFX_PWRGD went low while console was on. Check output filtering C8D1, C8D2, C8D4, C8E1, C8E5, C8E8, C8E10. General corrosion / timing problem in NCP area? Replace NCP
U5F3 I2C unreachable -> Check surrounding traces, R5F12, R5F15, replace U5F3

V_SB2P5, V_SB1P1, V_SB1P8 timeout, unable to unreset southbridge. Check short on V_SB2P5, V_SB1P1, V_SB1P8, replace U3D3, U3E1 or U3D5 or surrounding resistors, check Check U3E3, R7T6, replace southbridge

Waiting for PSP Boot Acknowledge finished, APU <-> SB communication failed on SMBUS3, no PSP boot acknowledge, check R4D31, R4D38. V_FUSE/V_SOC1P8 unavailable, check resistance and voltage on both, if missing U5C3 or U6D1 related. Cause can be APU no
PSP Power-On Reset spew wait done, unable to unreset APU, APU stuck in reset -> Check R5R9, R5T10, reball APU, APU.
SOC flash access wait done, check R4F17. V_SOCPHY related or APU
SOC POST (Power-On Self-Test) wait done, seen with cracked apu, faulty CPU?

XSS wait timeout (SOC not responding) (MOST COMMON CAUSE U5B2 DAMAGED/MISSING) - error fallback 0xeb46 right AFTER 0x007x - VTT[ABCD]/V_Memio timeout, check resistances & voltage. 0xeb46 right AFTER 0x045x - APU <-> VRM CONTROLLER SVI2 communication
XSS wait timeout fallback path (word_20000090 nonzero)
SOC power OK complete, problem with COLD_RESET_N. Check R4F19, R4G1, southbridge.
Conditional POST on XSSActiveWait() return < 0 - XSS wait failed - early abort

seen with V_3P3_ENET short, late V3P3 shutdown or low? Usually communication issue on PEX between southbridge <-> APU, check C7E1, C7E3, C7E5, C7E7, C7E6, C7E8 / traces corrosion, replace southbridge, reball apu.
Unexpected PSP Boot Ack not received

PIM boot ack or early boot signal incomplete
Triggered if SOC_SyncFlood() returns true. APU -> RAM communication failed while on. reball/replace rams, reball apu

General Error/ byproduct, low priority. Happens if sub_10001532 fails after repeated attempts maybe Timeout waiting for PCIe device. Southbridge did no reset properly due to APU reset/syncfllod/power fault.
General Error/ byproduct, low priority. PLL_Clk_Maybe() failed, likely clock not stable. Southbridge Timing, Clock generation fault. corrosion around SB/crystal oscilator?
General Error - Often byproduct, low priority. Last code before EC04 is usually the actual error
General Error - Often byproduct, low priority. Last code before EC04 is usually the actual error.
General Error - Often byproduct, low priority. Last code before EC04 is usually the actual error.

APU to SB: Thermal trip -> Check R5R8, R5R7, traces, reball southbridge or apu, apu tempsensor fault. Is the console just overheating?
General memory error (MEM <-> APU), check both V_Memio / and 4 VTT A-D resistances&voltages, check resistors around rams, replace rams (ZQ method?), reball apu.
Thrown when console unplugged unexpectedly. Can be caused by a partially bad U4C3 or short on V_5P0_GATED, V_5P0_ODD or V_5P0_HDD.

APU to SB: Thermal trip -> Can be caused by missing V_SOC1P8, check U5D2, R6D6, R5D6. Check R5T27, R5T3, R5E12, R5T7, R5E11, U5E2, R5E9, R5E8, R5T42, apu tempsensor fault. Short on C7D1? Is the apu just too hot?
General memory error (MEM <-> APU), check V_Memio / VTT A-D resistances&voltages, check resistors around rams, replace rams (ZQ method?), reball apu.
Thrown with memory error on ONE S
User report: Possible APU failure, pressing on APU throws different errors, reball APU
no codes while standby, after powerbuttonpress; 30 sec on/off: SSD undetected. Check SSD Health in PC with Crystaldiskinfo

Known unknown, Usually communication issue on PEX between southbridge <-> APU, reseat >board to board flex< (is B2B flex or connector damaged?). Some very tiny capacitors near B2B connector and back of apu cause this error. Replace southbridge, rebal
1 sec on/off: Thrown with SSD missmatch, possibly corrupted/bad ssd?

APU lost communication with RAM -> Usually APU reball needed. replace/reball rams, bad apu? Tip: By cooling console with external fan, can stop crashing. Reason: Less heat = Less board bend = cracked balls stay together.
Seen with Missmatched SSD. Corrupted NOR/SSD.
Seen with Faulty SSD, check in crystaldiskinfo. Corrupted NOR/SSD?
Seen with Faulty SSD, check in crystaldiskinfo. Corrupted NOR/SSD?
Corrupted NOR, dump SPI_FLASH and ask for repair on discord.
Apu (PSP) thermal trip on start -> Heatsink installed?
APU Thermal shutdown while on. Heatsink installed, thermal paste good, fan working?
U57 thermal Error, replace U57. TSENS pin problem?
U480 thermal Error, replace U480. TSENS pins problem?
Known unknown, thrown with 62FC when removing FB0. U17 unable to bring up PCIE CLock lines?
Known unknown, thrown with 01C0 when removing FB0. U17 unable to bring up PCIE CLock lines?
